definitions.gloss: splitting evenly; dividing in half; going halves
definitions.explanation: Dividing something, typically a cost or expense, equally between two parties. Very commonly used when splitting a bill or sharing expenses.

examples.japanese: ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We split the cost in half.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ルームメイト→ルームメイト：24411_ruumumeito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I split the rent with my roommate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: We decided to split the travel expenses between the two of us.

notes:
Literally 'breaking in half.' {折半|せっぱん} always implies an exact 50-50 split between two parties.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to split the cost
- ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to split the rent
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{折半|せっぱん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go halves with someone

CONTRAST WITH {割|わ}り{勘|かん}:
- {折半|せっぱん}: general term for splitting any expense equally (rent, travel, project costs)
- ⟦{割|わ}り{勘|かん}→割り勘：08156_warikan⟧: specifically splitting a restaurant or drinking bill among a group (can be more than two people)

USAGE:
Common in both casual and business contexts. Often used for recurring shared expenses like rent or utilities, not just one-time payments.
